findings.detail: [agent].forward is "yes", but no ssh-agent answers on this machine. Sessions and commands still open with agent forwarding requested, and a program on the host that asks for a key gets a failure.
findings.remedy: Start ssh-agent and ssh-add your key (on Windows, start the ssh-agent service), or check SSH_AUTH_SOCK. To stop forwarding, run `qsh config set agent.forward no`.
